title: Zesty Crisp Brazilian Onion Sushi
description: A jammy and crisp weeknight Brazilian dish featuring yellow onion, nigiri-shaping, and jain-friendly ingredients, this recipe is perfect for a quick dinner
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat
Add the sliced yellow onion and cook until it is caramelized and jammy
Add the brazilian spice blend, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine
Add the cooked sushi rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the onion mixture
Using your hands, shape the rice mixture into small nigiri shapes
Place the nigiri shapes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper
Drizzle the apple cider vinegar over the top of the nigiri shapes
Bake the nigiri shapes in a preheated oven at 400 degrees for 10 minutes
Remove the nigiri shapes from the oven and garnish with chopped fresh cilantro if desired
